explanation: The landing's article opens its § Background with the defeat: "After the Battle of Annual in July 1921, the Spanish army was unable to regain control of the central Rif region. It undertook a containment policy aimed at preventing the expansion of the rebel zone… In parallel, the Minister of War ordered the creation of an inquiry commission" — out of which came the agreements that included "the plan for a Spanish landing on the Alhucemas bay". The article also says the target was not new: "All Spanish land operations, included the Disaster of Annual in 1921, were aimed at the occupation of Alhucemas". `precondition-of` is therefore the exact claim — Annual is the situation the landing was planned out of, not its cause — and the landing is what "would put an end to the Rif War" the two records share as their parent. `probable` (rule 22).
